Subject: Final sweep: QBR slate finalization & exec binder handoff

Team —

We need a final pass on the QBR slate for Helio before I assemble the leadership binder on Monday. Please do the following by EOD Monday (12/21):

- Confirm stage for each commit in your owner list and add the short reason in the “Stage Note” column of the attached exec-pack-template.xlsx (use codes: A=Commit, B=At Risk, C=Pipeline).
- Flag any deals > $250k with a one-sentence mitigation plan and true close date.
- If a deal has been moved between stages within the last 30 days, attach a one-line explanation and reference the stage-change-log.csv template.

I’ll consolidate into the Leadership Binder (QBR-Leadership-Binder-2026.pdf) and share with Markus + Helio’s execs for pre-read. Clare at Helio is on the loop for sign-off — cc’ing legal only if we need a redline/term exception.

Attachments: exec-pack-template.xlsx (template)

Thanks — keep notes short; leadership will only see the summarized reasons.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Manager, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

> Team —
>

Thanks, Jasmine. Quick clarifications:

1) For the >$250k flag — do you want us to include the AR history (past 6 months) in the note or keep it to a one-line mitigation? I can add a short AR bullet if useful.
2) There are three deals I marked as “At Risk” because of outstanding security review. Should I set their expected close to next quarter in the template or leave as “TBD” and call them out in the leader summary?

I’ve started filling the exec template for my owners — will finish by EOD Monday.

Heads up — I completed my section and attached the stage-change-log.csv with three recent transitions (dates + brief rationale). A couple of notes:

- Deal HEL-472 (Helio) was moved from Opportunity -> Commit on 12/15 after a private pricing call. I put the original commit-owner and the updated expected ship month in the template.
- For the security-blocked deals Karthik flagged, I added "Contingency: Demo+POC in Jan; Legal FAQ pending" as the mitigation line so leadership understands the path.
- I kept AR history as a one-line metric "Net ARR collection 90d: $X" for any deal above $350k. If you want the full ledger, let me know and I’ll drop the ledger link.

Attachments: stage-change-log.csv

Team — thank you. I consolidated the inputs and produced the Leadership Binder (QBR-Leadership-Binder-2026.pdf) in the shared Drive link. Summary of next steps:

- Markus: please review the 2-page executive summary (tabs: top risks, upside universe) and confirm any edits by Tue 9am PT.
- Laura/Karthik: I left the security-blocked deals as "At Risk" but included the mitigation lines you provided. If we get a positive security update, I will move them to Commit and update the Leadership Binder.
- Monica: please confirm billing/contact cadence for Deal HEL-472 before I send the pre-read to Clare.

Clare — sharing for visibility. We’ll aim to get the binder to Helio execs by Wed morning; if there are any compliance/redline needs please let us know and we will pull in LegalOps.

Attachments: QBR-Leadership-Binder-2026.pdf
